references.text: The cloud led the people of Israel through the wilderness as a visible manifestation of God's presence and guidance.
The cloud over the tabernacle determined when the Israelites should break camp and move on.
A detailed description of how the cloud directed Israel's journeys and encampments in the wilderness.
The people traveled from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran, confirming their route.
Moses sent out spies from the Wilderness of Paran, showing that the people were in this area.
The spies returned to Kadesh in the Wilderness of Paran.
Moses reminds the people of the journey from Horeb through the great and fearful wilderness toward Paran.
Paran is mentioned as a place where the Lord revealed Himself to His people.
The Wilderness of Paran is also mentioned in connection with Ishmael, highlighting the region's geographical significance.
